notes: «ومن حديث» and «21 -» are leading words, left out; «سمعت رسول الله يقول» makes Jabir the last link, the Prophet ends the chain

«ثم تكلم بشيء لم أسمعه، قال: فسألت القوم وسألت أبي ... فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش» is a second statement after the first saying: the father who answers is not named as a link here; needs a ruling (two sayings in one report, second without a settled isnad)
